description:
Ethereum mainnet NFT (ERC-721) owner of a token id. Ethereum NFT holdings: the token IDs a wallet owns in one ERC-721 Enumerable collection on Ethereum mainnet. Takes token (the ERC-721 collection contract) and owner (the wallet address). Pay $0.005 in USDC on Base per call.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_erc721_tokensof. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_erc721_tokensof
